ops.title: stackQueueStates panic: Graphite pull-request-info answers heads it was not asked about
ops.body: ccx v0.74.5/0.74.6 panicked (nil deref, addr 0xd0 = stackRebaseBranch.PR offset) in stackQueueStates at stackrebase.go:2149 because Graphite's pull-request-info, asked about N head refs, also returns open PRs from the remote stack that the local stack lacks (monorepo 2026-10-07: asked pulumi-policy-delete, pulumi-replace-no-delete, pulumi-pending-creates-skill; Graphite also returned #31935 pulumi-rebake-leftover-hold). Deterministic, not caused by the concurrent GitHub 502. Fix #313 (v0.74.7): filter infos to asked heads before reading mergeability. Any caller of PullRequestInfo with PRHeadRefNames must not assume the answer is a subset of the question.
